verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a network-connectivity and VPN product. An in-app terminal file editor with syntax and lint checking belongs to SSH-client or IDE products, so this axis is a category error, much like asking a VPN to commit and push code. Testimonials about SSH-ing into boxes or coding from an iPad describe users' own remote editors reached over the network, not a Tailscale capability, so they do not make the axis apply.
